''See also: [[suppression field Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A suppression field is a powerful [[technique]] that functions as an advanced version of a [[boundary field]] by commanding the area itself rather than just the [[aura]] within it. These fields act as an even-handed curse that affects everyone inside, draining power and ability from those within its reach. The more an individual has advanced in power, the more the field takes from them. This effect can diminish [[spiritual perception]], [[aura]] sight, and even physical force, making it difficult for individuals to utilize their full techniques or express their powers. Beyond affecting people, the field is designed to weaken massive entities like [[Dreadgods]] or [[Titans]] within minutes. It requires a power source to function, which may manifest as a [[ring]] around a mountain. While the field can be used to hide individuals from being scanned by others, it can also be deactivated or inverted. In some instances, the field's presence around specific locations like [[Sacred Valley]] can reveal imbalances in a person's body and [[spirit]], particularly if they enter the field shortly after advancing in power.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|A suppression field initially identifies an imbalance within [[Yerin's spirit]] and body. Within the [[Sacred Valley]], a suppression field is maintained that a [[Monarch]] was anticipated to circle. This phenomenon appears again at the boundary where [[Eithan]]'s [[technique]] failed, while simultaneously dampening [[Lindon]]'s presence. Finally, a suppression field covers the combat area, prompting the [[Titan]] to attempt an escape from its influence.}}
